<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="20" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="327" y1="16" x2="332" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="327" y1="13" x2="332" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="327" y1="10" x2="332" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="17" x2="337" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="17" x2="341" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="17" x2="345" y2="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="358" cy="13" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="356" y1="15" x2="353" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="367" y="7" width="18" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="369" y="9" width="12" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="385" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  
  <!-- header -->
  <text x="22" y="67" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="25" font-weight="500" fill="#0901A7">Bills</text>
  <circle cx="352" cy="58" r="18" fill="#9FD9FC"/>
  <circle cx="352" cy="53" r="5" fill="#0275BA"/>
  <ellipse cx="352" cy="65" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#0275BA"/>
  
  <!-- tab switcher -->
  <rect x="18" y="89" width="354" height="48" rx="24" fill="#F2F7FA"/>
  <rect x="20" y="91" width="171" height="44" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="105" y="119" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#0901A7">Payments</text>
  <text x="280" y="119" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#676767">Requests</text>
  
  <!-- action buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="158" width="168" height="48" rx="24" fill="#0275BA"/>
    <text x="104" y="188" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Send money</text>
    <line x1="55" y1="182" x2="55" y2="193" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="187" x2="60" y2="187" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="202" y="158" width="168" height="48" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="286" y="188" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">Request money</text>
    <line x1="239" y1="182" x2="239" y2="193" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="234" y1="187" x2="244" y2="187" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- section heading -->
  <text x="20" y="246" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Upcoming bills</text>
  <text x="370" y="245" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">Manage</text>
  <line x1="20" y1="258" x2="370" y2="258" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- empty state illustration shadow/card -->
  <rect x="20" y="278" width="350" height="270" rx="18" fill="#C2C2C2" opacity="0.18"/>
  <rect x="20" y="276" width="350" height="270" rx="18" fill="#F7FBFD"/>
  
  <!-- illustration -->
  <rect x="142" y="307" width="106" height="82" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9FD9FC" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="154" y="320" width="42" height="8" rx="4" fill="#9FD9FC"/>
  <rect x="154" y="338" width="71" height="7" rx="3" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <rect x="154" y="353" width="55" height="7" rx="3" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <circle cx="225" cy="373" r="18" fill="#3EB3F9"/>
  <line x1="217" y1="373" x2="233" y2="373" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="225" y1="365" x2="225" y2="381" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="118,389 135,371 151,389" fill="#9FD9FC"/>
  <polygon points="235,389 253,367 276,389" fill="#7CCEFF"/>
  <circle cx="270" cy="352" r="8" fill="#FFD469"/>
  
  <text x="195" y="430" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="500" fill="#0901A7">No bills yet</text>
  <text x="195" y="458" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Your subscriptions and bills will</text>
  <text x="195" y="478" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">appear here when they're added.</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="105" y="499" width="180" height="34" rx="17" fill="#E8F6FE"/>
    <text x="195" y="521" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">Add a bill or subscription</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- lower information section -->
  <text x="20" y="590" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Pay with PayPal</text>
  <text x="20" y="616" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Keep payments organized and protected in one place.</text>
  
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="638" width="350" height="72" rx="14" fill="#C2C2C2" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="20" y="636" width="350" height="72" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="56" cy="672" r="21" fill="#28308A"/>
    <text x="56" y="679" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">P</text>
    <text x="91" y="664" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#000000">Simple, secure payments</text>
    <text x="91" y="687" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Choose PayPal at checkout wherever you shop.</text>
    <polyline points="342,668 348,674 342,680" fill="none" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="744" width="390" height="100" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="744" x2="390" y2="744" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,776 50,767 61,776" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="43" y="775" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="50" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Home</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Wallet -->
  <g>
    <rect x="108" y="770" width="27" height="19" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="108" y1="776" x2="135" y2="776" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="125" y="778" width="8" height="5" rx="2" fill="#676767"/>
    <text x="121" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Wallet</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Send -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="779" r="14" fill="#E8F6FE"/>
    <line x1="188" y1="786" x2="202" y2="772" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="195,772 202,772 202,779" fill="none" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Send</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Bills selected -->
  <g>
    <rect x="263" y="766" width="50" height="28" rx="14" fill="#E8F6FE"/>
    <rect x="275" y="772" width="18" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="279" y1="777" x2="289" y2="777" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="279" y1="781" x2="289" y2="781" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="279" y1="785" x2="286" y2="785" stroke="#0275BA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="288" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0275BA">Bills</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Activity -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="355" cy="777" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="355,770 355,778 361,782" fill="none" stroke="#676767" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="355" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#676767">Activity</text>
  </g>
</svg>
